description_en: Call the DescribeConfigVersionDifference operation to compare the parameter values of an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse community-compatible cluster before and after a configuration change
description_zh: 调用DescribeConfigVersionDifference接口查看云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群配置参数变更前后的参数值
name: DescribeConfigVersionDifference

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query the IDs of all clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change record. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452209.html operation to query the IDs of change records
parameters.help_zh: 变更记录的ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452209.html接口查询变更记录的ID
parameters.name: change_id
